title: Chief Data Officer (CDO) — Insurance & Investments
description: Job Summary The Chief Data Officer (CDO) is responsible for the organization's enterprise-wide data strategy, governance, quality, analytics, AI, and data-driven transformation. Support investment teams with portfolio analytics, market data, performance reporting, and investment intelligence. Establish data KPIs and monitor data quality and governance performance. Lead data transformation and modernization initiatives. Manage relationships with data, analytics, AI, and technology vendors. Build and lead data, analytics, BI, governance, and data-science teams. Promote an enterprise-wide data-driven culture. Present data strategy, risks, opportunities, and transformation progress to executive leadership and the Board. Ideal Candidate Profile 15+ years of progressive experience in data, analytics, technology, information management, or financial-services data. 5+ years in CDO, Chief Data Officer, Head of Data, Director of Data, Head of Analytics, or equivalent senior leadership positions. Experience in insurance, investment management, asset management, banking, wealth management, or financial services preferred. Strong expertise in: Enterprise data strategy Data governance Data architecture Data quality & master data Business intelligence Advanced analytics AI / machine learning Data privacy & security Data management Data integration Regulatory data Cloud data platforms Strong understanding of financial-services data and regulatory requirements. Experience managing enterprise data transformation programs and large multidisciplinary teams. Strong C-suite, Board, and business stakeholder engagement. description: Parachute Health is transforming post-acute care as the leading digital ordering platform for medical equipment and supplies. We connect major health systems, health plans, and suppliers to help patients get the life-saving products they need at home. Since launching, we've connected 300,000+ clinicians and 3,000+ supplier locations across all 50 states and helped 15M+ patients. What started as a DME ePrescribing tool has become the order management platform of choice for home medical equipment. Join our team and make a difference in patient care. About the Role The Lead Data Analyst is the senior individual contributor on our Data Analytics team — a Level IV role on our analytics ladder, with no direct reports. Data Analytics sits under Revenue Operations, but we're a central function that supports the entire organization — clinical operations, supplier performance, payor and network data, product, finance, and go-to-market. We're hiring for analytical strength and range, not depth in one domain. Design dashboards and reporting frameworks that let stakeholders answer their own routine questions without opening a ticket — and recognize when a dashboard is the wrong answer. Set the bar for analytical rigor, methodology, and documentation. By example and by reviewing others' work, not by mandate. Apply statistical methods, experimentation design, and causal inference where they sharpen a conclusion rather than decorate it. Move between business domains and be credible in each, rather than owning one. Partner with leadership to identify where data can drive efficiency, growth, and improve outcomes — including the questions nobody has asked yet. Das Umfeld geht Richtung Cloud First: Azure und Microsoft 365 stehen im Fokus, und du entscheidest mit, was wann dorthin wandert. Du bist hier weniger der Zeichner am Reißbrett als der Statiker auf der Baustelle – deine Konzepte müssen tragen, und du legst selbst mit Hand an. WICHTIG: 100% Remote nach einer 3-6 monatigen Einarbeitung in Unna! Deine Aufgaben Lösungen von A bis Z: Du nimmst fachliche Anforderungen auf, entwickelst daraus gemeinsam mit dem Team Lösungskonzepte und begleitest sie bis in den stabilen Betrieb. Cloud First mitgestalten: Du bist federführend mit dabei, Azure, M365 und die hybride Identity weiterzuentwickeln – und denkst mit, welcher Weg dorthin realistisch ist. Optionen abwägen: Du schaust dir Lösungswege mit Blick auf Sicherheit, Skalierbarkeit, Wirtschaftlichkeit und Betriebsfähigkeit an und hältst Entscheidungen nachvollziehbar fest. Umsetzen und weitergeben: Du baust neue Themen mit auf, statt sie nur zu konzipieren, und nimmst das sechsköpfige Team dabei mit. Dein Profil Microsoft-Cloud im Alltag: Du arbeitest seit einigen Jahren mit Azure und M365 – Identity, Collaboration, Endpoint – und hast Migrationen aus On-Premises-Umgebungen schon begleitet.
